video_title: The NBA’s Analytics Debate Explained (With Brian Windhorst)

quotes.speaker: Iman Shumpert
quotes.summary_phrase: Iman Shumpert questions the Celtics' analytical valuation of Jaylen Brown
quotes.excerpt: hearing Jaylen Brown was not as valuable as Derek White, that's just such a wild statement
quotes.quote: The Celtics analytic thing, I'm curious to know what everybody knows about what they're breaking down and what they're seeing valuable. Hearing Jaylen Brown was not as valuable as Derek White, that's just such a wild statement to me. Being somebody that played, how do you look at analytics and say we need to get Mitchell Robinson off the floor? Or Derek White is—what is their system? I'm trying to understand, I really am. I'm trying at this point because that's just such a wild statement to me.

quotes.speaker: Brian Windhorst
quotes.summary_phrase: Brian Windhorst explains how the NBA's new CBA impacts team building
quotes.excerpt: it wasn't that they didn't want to keep Mitch, it was that they couldn't afford to keep him
quotes.quote: In this era where you're talking about the Knicks, it wasn't that they didn't want to keep Mitch, it was that they couldn't afford to keep him. Back before the aprons, it was like, well, if we spent more money, it just meant the owner wrote a bigger check. It really came down to how much is your owner willing to spend. Because if you're willing to spend, you could have everybody. And some teams did. There were teams that paid 300 million dollars or 200 million dollars just in luxury tax.

quotes.speaker: Brian Windhorst
quotes.summary_phrase: Brian Windhorst details the harsh penalties of the NBA's second apron
quotes.excerpt: they can say to you, we're going to take your draft pick
quotes.quote: These new rules with the aprons, it doesn't just take away your ability, it's expensive. They start taking stuff away from you. They can say to you, we're going to take your draft pick, and if you spend in the second apron a couple years in a row, we take your draft pick, no matter what your record is, no matter what happens in the lottery, and we put your draft pick to the back. And it's not this year, five years from now. So you're totally mortgaging your present and future.

quotes.speaker: Brian Windhorst
quotes.summary_phrase: Brian Windhorst on how teams define player value under the new CBA
quotes.excerpt: they're talking about its value relative to how much it costs you on their on your books
quotes.quote: Nowadays in the NBA, when they talk about value, they're not just talking about what the player's contribution is to the team today, this year. They're talking about its value relative to how much it costs you on their on your books. When they say value, they're not saying that you're coming out and you got to win a game and you're either picking Jaylen Brown to be on your team or Derek White. They're not arguing who's the better player. When they say value, they're looking at what a player's production is versus how much he costs.

quotes.speaker: Brian Windhorst
quotes.summary_phrase: Brian Windhorst on the Celtics' statistical preference for Derek White over Jaylen Brown
quotes.excerpt: the Celtics were a better team this year with Derek White on the court versus Jaylen Brown
quotes.quote: The Celtics were a better team this year with Derek White on the court versus Jaylen Brown. Now you can debate that and say that that's just not true, and I'm not defending their side. But the numbers that they have say that when Derek White played and Jaylen Brown played, they were better with Derek White, that Derek White defensively had an elite season, he was first team all defense, and that he cost 20 million dollars less.

quotes.speaker: Iman Shumpert
quotes.summary_phrase: Iman Shumpert questions the validity of comparing Jaylen Brown and Jayson Tatum
quotes.excerpt: we've seen Jaylen Brown operate without Jayson Tatum. We've never seen Jayson Tatum operate without Jaylen Brown
quotes.quote: What do the numbers say about Jayson Tatum next to Jaylen Brown? We've seen Jaylen Brown operate without Jayson Tatum. We've never seen Jayson Tatum operate without Jaylen Brown. We're either about to see a huge growth out of Jayson Tatum or we're going to see some question marks. But I know what Jaylen Brown be on. I've seen how you have to guard Jaylen Brown and then how you have to guard Jayson Tatum and Jaylen Brown's on the court and they got three-point shooting around.

quotes.speaker: Brian Windhorst
quotes.summary_phrase: Brian Windhorst compares the net ratings of Jayson Tatum and Jaylen Brown
quotes.excerpt: Tatum's was about roughly double Brown's
quotes.quote: When you look at each of their net rating, which is the effect of the score when they're on the court, Tatum's was about roughly double Brown's. The score was positive to the Celtics twice as good with Tatum on the court versus Brown. Now, man is that a loaded sentence. You could shoot Swiss cheese into that 500 different ways because there are so many different variables on that.
